newsitem.title: USA: Montana 700 MW Colstrip 4 restart delayed to Sat.
newsitem.headline: Montana 700 MW Colstrip 4 restart delayed to Sat.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant near Billings, Montana, will not be restarted until Saturday, a spokesman for Montana Power Co said Thursday.
The unit was shut early last Saturday morning for repairs to a heater gear box and was originally expected to restart on Sunday.
Colstrip's other units, two at 330 MW and another at 700 MW, were operating normally, the spokesman said.
Montana Power is the operator of Colstrip unit 4 and is responsible for the sale of 30 percent of its power output under long-term contracts.

Equity owners include Puget Sound Power and Light Co, Washington Water Power Co, Portland General Electric Co, Pacific Power and Light, and a consortium made up of GE Credit, Shell Oil Co and a lease-back consortium.
